projects.title: On-Chip Offline Learning for Energy-Efficient Neuromorphic Accelerator
projects.description: Ongoing research project exploring local, on-chip learning for energy-efficient SNN acceleration using event-driven computation.
projects.longDescription: Ongoing research project focused on designing a neuromorphic accelerator that supports offline on-chip learning for spiking neural networks (SNNs). The work investigates learning rules compatible with hardware constraints (e.g., local spike-timing/activity traces) and explores architectural trade-offs in synaptic memory organization, sparse event processing, and update precision to improve energy efficiency.
features: On-chip synaptic update mechanism for offline adaptation

projects.title: Peak Load Detection System
projects.description: Edge AI-based IoT system for real-time industrial peak power detection using an ensemble ML detector across dual live dashboards.
projects.longDescription: Built an Edge AI-based IoT system that detects peak industrial power demand in real time using an ESP32 sensor node, Python edge inference, and dual dashboards (Node-RED for live monitoring, Grafana for historical analysis). Sensor readings are evaluated through an ensemble of Threshold, Z-score, and Isolation Forest detectors and streamed over a decoupled MQTT architecture into a Dockerized backend pipeline for ingestion, storage, and dashboarding of sensor telemetry.
features: Real-time peak detection via ensemble ML (Threshold + Z-score + Isolation Forest)
Dual dashboards: Node-RED for live monitoring, Grafana for historical trends
Dockerized backend pipeline for ingestion, storage, and dashboarding
Fully configurable thresholds, polling rates, and detection algorithms
projects.myContribution: Developed the Dockerized backend pipeline (MQTT/InfluxDB/Grafana/Node-RED) handling ingestion, storage, and dashboarding of sensor telemetry.

projects.title: Gayani Communications POS System
projects.description: Offline-first Point of Sale and business management desktop app built for a small retail communications shop.
projects.longDescription: Designed and built a fully local Point of Sale and business management desktop application for Gayani Communication & Book Shop, packaged as a Windows Electron app so it runs entirely offline with no cloud dependency. Includes a live dashboard with KPIs and revenue charts, a billing screen with PDF invoice generation and printing, inventory management with low-stock alerts, sales history with filtering and refunds, and reporting on revenue trends and top products.
features: Dashboard with KPIs, revenue chart, recent bills, and low-stock alerts
Billing screen with live calculations, PDF invoice generation, and printing
Inventory management with add/edit/soft-delete and low-stock filtering
Sales history with filters, bill view modal, and refund handling
Reports for revenue trend, top products, and inventory value
Packaged as a Windows desktop app (Electron) that runs fully offline
projects.myContribution: Designed and built the full system end-to-end (React/Vite frontend, Express/MongoDB backend, and Electron packaging) as a freelance deployment for a retail shop client.
